checks.description: Selects existing sources instead of proposing a second document suite.
Finds product-mode, default-read, decision, and completion-evidence conflicts without reporting semantic PASS.
Does not read every control document for an ordinary small change.
Maps API and architecture changes to the corresponding authority and decision review.
Leaves git status clean for the assessment task.
For a separate persistent-change trial, produces no more than one root-Agent compact entry.
